narrative.overview: Military Suite is an administrative event log and reporting interface designed for high-density historical record-keeping, documentation, and reporting. The visual philosophy prioritizes immediate legibility, dark-adapted operational comfort, and rigorous tabular and card layout clarity.
keyCharacteristics: High Information Density with structured tactical grids
Tonal Layering through Slate depth progression
Precision Monospace Metrics for timestamps and casualty totals
Calm Administrative Statuses without artificial AI gradients

rules.name: The Legibility First Rule
rules.body: Loss ratios and key metric digits must always be rendered in solid high-contrast colors rather than gradient text.

rules.name: The Tonal Layering Rule
rules.body: Surfaces rely on dark tone progressions and 1px borders rather than ambient drop shadows.

dos: Do provide clear aria-label attributes on every icon-only button
Do format all dates, timestamps, ratios, and statistics with monospace typography
Do ensure all text color combinations meet WCAG AA contrast (4.5:1)
donts: Don't add decorative side-tab stripes (w-1, border-l-4) to cards
Don't use gradient text (bg-clip-text) on numerical values or statistics
Don't use purple/violet neon gradients on military administrative surfaces
